clue.text: Performance that can't be seen morning, noon or night!

definitions.text: Performance that can't be seen morning, noon or night!

parts.words: Performance that can't be seen morning, noon or night!
parts.note: a show staged only in the afternoon, so it is never on in the morning, at midday or in the evening

explanation.surface: A show so elusive that nobody can catch it at any time of day.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre's afternoon showing falls between noon and evening, missing all three named times.

clue.text: Agitated, sardonic Catholic leaves a pagan figure

indicators.note: agitated letters are stirred up, so what remains of the word gets rearranged
leaves means the Catholic abbreviation departs from the word sardonic

parts.note: RC is the usual abbreviation for Roman Catholic

explanation.surface: A mocking Catholic storms out, leaving behind a heathen idol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' takes R and C out of SARDONIC, giving SADONI; 'Agitated' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: The beautiful youth loved by the goddess Aphrodite is a figure of Greek pagan myth.

clue.text: Illuminated as Noah would have liked, perhaps

definitions.text: Illuminated as Noah would have liked, perhaps

parts.words: Illuminated as Noah would have liked, perhaps
parts.note: Noah, afloat in the Ark through the deluge, might have wished the waters lit up so he could see them

explanation.surface: Lighting arranged to suit the builder of the Ark.
explanation.definitionFit: Lit by powerful lamps, as a stadium at night is illuminated.

clue.text: Abrasive sort of trouble?

parts.note: a predicament, or a graze, which is literally the kind of trouble made by rubbing

explanation.surface: Wondering what kind of difficulty grinds on you.
explanation.definitionFit: A tight spot or predicament, which is also the word for scraping a surface.

clue.text: Birds support quarrels!

parts.note: a spar is a pole that supports rigging
rows are noisy arguments

explanation.surface: Feathered creatures prop each other up, then fall out.
explanation.definitionFit: Small brown songbirds common in towns and gardens.

clue.text: Put money into circulation, it's said

definitions.meaning: to utter coin, especially forged coin, is to pass it into use

explanation.surface: Counterfeit cash was passed on, so the rumour goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Voiced aloud, and in law passed forged notes into circulation.

clue.text: At the head of the army a young chap retreats, doing much harm

definitions.note: an adjectival phrase for a noun answer: a person who is doing much harm

parts.words: At the head of the army
parts.note: the van, short for vanguard, is the front of an advancing army

indicators.note: retreats means the young chap goes backwards in the reading

parts.note: a lad is a young man

explanation.surface: A youth leading the troops falls back, causing havoc.
explanation.walkthrough: VAN as the front of an army is a military term, short for vanguard. The definition describes what the person does rather than naming them, so it fits loosely.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrecker who deliberately damages property.

clue.text: Card carrying flower, perhaps, is the big prize

indicators.note: carrying means the card has the flower piece attached next to it

parts.note: the jack is a court card in a pack
pot is cannabis, whose flowering buds are smoked

explanation.surface: A playing card bearing a bloom turns out to be the top reward.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest prize in a lottery or gambling game.

clue.text: Before morning, rapid craft is thrown into the sea

definitions.note: a participle phrase for a noun answer: goods thrown overboard

indicators.note: Before places the aircraft piece ahead of the morning abbreviation

parts.note: jet's, a contraction of 'jet is', a fast aircraft
AM stands for ante meridiem, morning

explanation.surface: Early in the day a speedboat is hurled into the waves.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rapid craft is' reads as 'jet's', giving JETS with no letter dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo jettisoned from a ship to lighten it.

clue.text: Director, as it were, on the way

definitions.text: Director, as it were, on the way

parts.words: Director, as it were, on the way
parts.note: not a film director but something by a road that directs travellers

explanation.surface: A film director spotted travelling along the road.
explanation.definitionFit: A roadside post bearing arms that point travellers towards places.

clue.text: Tortured marine reveals other Service personnel

indicators.note: tortured letters are twisted out of shape into a new order

explanation.surface: A marine under torment betrays members of a rival branch.
explanation.definitionFit: Members of the air force, a fighting service other than the marines.

clue.text: A creature full of ease!

parts.note: a small animal whose name has the word ease sitting inside it

explanation.surface: An animal wholly relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: A small slender carnivore related to the stoat.

clue.text: Blooms: a thousand seen on a tip

indicators.note: tipped over, so the letters are tumbled into a new order

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: Flowers by the thousand spotted on a rubbish dump.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on a tip' rearranges A, M and SEENON together. A British 'tip' is a rubbish dump, the surface's picture.
explanation.definitionFit: Flowers of the buttercup family, with bright cup-shaped petals.

clue.text: Type of heavenly dwarf is colourless!…

definitions.meaning: a small dense dead star in astronomy

explanation.surface: A small star in the sky has lost all its colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A white dwarf is a type of star; the colour also means pale and drained.

clue.text: Punishment for drinking after hours?

parts.note: not a fine for illegal late drinking but the headache that follows hours later

explanation.surface: The penalty for drinking in a pub after closing time.
explanation.definitionFit: The headache and nausea suffered the morning after heavy drinking.

clue.text: And this type of hit is great to break

definitions.text: And this type of hit is great
definitions.meaning: a huge success, as in a hit show or record

explanation.surface: A great hit can be shattering.
explanation.definitionFit: A runaway success is a smash hit; to shatter something is to smash it.

clue.text: Novel beast

parts.note: not a new kind of animal but an animal from a famous book

explanation.surface: A newly discovered animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Herman Melville's white whale, title character of his novel.

clue.text: Fancy building them in Spain!

parts.note: the idiom of building such things in Spain means daydreaming of impossible schemes

explanation.surface: Imagine putting up fortresses in Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Castles in Spain, like castles in the air, are fanciful dreams.

clue.text: Checked out like a beast, seemingly

definitions.meaning: treated as an animal is by the animal doctor

explanation.surface: Inspected as though one were an animal.
explanation.definitionFit: Screened carefully, as an animal doctor examines a patient.

clue.text: Being sensible regarding a court case!

definitions.meaning: a trial or session before a judge

explanation.surface: Being reasonable about a legal action.
explanation.definitionFit: The faculty of perceiving sound; also the trial of a case in court.

clue.text: Clean out somewhere to drink first, and get shellfish

indicators.note: first puts the drinking place ahead of the rearranged letters

parts.note: a bar serves drinks

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the word clean are put out of order

explanation.surface: Scrub out the pub before collecting seafood.
explanation.definitionFit: A crustacean that clings to rocks and ship hulls, loosely called shellfish.

clue.text: Wild she-cat plays false

indicators.note: wild letters run amok and settle in a new order

explanation.surface: A feral female cat behaves dishonestly.
explanation.definitionFit: Acts dishonestly to gain an advantage.

clue.text: Take the trouble to utter a mild oath

definitions.meaning: an exclamation of annoyance, a gentle curse

explanation.surface: Making an effort to swear softly.
explanation.definitionFit: To make the effort; also a gentle exclamation of irritation.

clue.text: Interfere with one who fixes the charge?

definitions.meaning: not someone setting a price but someone ramming an explosive charge into a drill hole

explanation.surface: Meddling with whoever sets the price.
explanation.definitionFit: To meddle; also a person who tamps down an explosive charge.

clue.text: Gentle touch can be a frightful body-blow!

definitions.meaning: a sudden seizure such as apoplexy

explanation.surface: A soft caress may be a terrible blow.
explanation.definitionFit: A caressing movement of the hand; also a sudden brain seizure.

clue.text: Sign of high water

parts.note: the line the sea leaves at its highest reach, or the ring left round a bath

explanation.surface: Evidence that a flood once came.
explanation.definitionFit: The line on a shore showing where the sea reached at its height.

clue.text: Chosen and beheaded-but still chosen!

indicators.note: beheaded means the first letter is cut off the word

parts.note: picked out from a group

explanation.surface: A ruler, picked, executed and still picked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'beheaded' drops the S from SELECTED; the result still means chosen, as by voters.
explanation.definitionFit: Picked by vote for an office.

clue.text: Tidies up lances found in disorder

indicators.note: the spears are found jumbled, so their letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A housekeeper sorting a jumble of spears.
explanation.definitionFit: Makes free of dirt and mess.
